_hackagent_comment: Red-team DETECTION-COVERAGE benchmark keyed to HackAgent's attack taxonomy (github.com/vistalabs-org/hackagent). Scored by scripts/redteam-eval.mjs — a SEPARATE, deterministic, LLM-free loop from the pass/fail `cases` above (which scripts/redteam.mjs and cli/moorai-redteam.mjs own). Each sample carries GROUND-TRUTH labels: `shouldDetect` (is this genuinely an attack?), `family` (HackAgent family), `category` (threat category), optional `expectThreat` (the ideal threat id — scoring's primary metric is any-finding, this is the secondary 'right-reason' metric). Kept out of `cases` on purpose: many families are known CURRENT misses (the gap signal), and putting an unmet `expect` in `cases` would (correctly) fail the strict npm-run-redteam gate. Content-free; encoded strings are precomputed constants so no code runs at load.
